name: help-board_preflight
stdout:
usage: board_preflight.py [-h] --config CONFIG

Fresh target-board inventory and checks only. Does not switch apps, services
or drivers.

optional arguments:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG  Annex config directory containing source_lock.json and
                   baseline_inputs.json

name: help-build_dfx
stdout:
usage: build_dfx.py [-h] --workspace WORKSPACE --sdk SDK --libdfx LIBDFX
                    --chrpath CHRPATH [--jobs JOBS]
                    [--runtime-root RUNTIME_ROOT] [--qemu QEMU]

Rebuild the fixed DFX source using an explicit installed SDK; never install
outputs.

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --workspace WORKSPACE
  --sdk SDK
  --libdfx LIBDFX
  --chrpath CHRPATH
  --jobs JOBS
  --runtime-root RUNTIME_ROOT
  --qemu QEMU

name: help-build_zocl
stdout:
usage: build_zocl.py [-h] --workspace WORKSPACE --sdk SDK
                     [--kernel-git KERNEL_GIT] [--jobs JOBS]
                     {prepare,kernel,module}

Prepare a separate matching kernel and build ZOCL; never load or install
modules.

positional arguments:
  {prepare,kernel,module}

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --workspace WORKSPACE
  --sdk SDK
  --kernel-git KERNEL_GIT
                        Required for prepare; fixed, clean linux-xlnx checkout
  --jobs JOBS

name: help-prepare_sources
stdout:
usage: prepare_sources.py [-h] --workspace WORKSPACE

Reconstruct fixed patched sources in a fresh directory; no network or board
access.

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --workspace WORKSPACE
